verdicts.sentence: A disk has $\chi = 1$; adding a through-hole reduces $\chi$ by 1.
verdicts.corrected: A disk (contractible 2-manifold with boundary) has Euler characteristic $\chi = 1$; each additional topological through-hole reduces $\chi$ by 1 (annulus: $\chi = 0$; pair-of-pants: $\chi = -1$) [Hatcher, *Algebraic Topology*, Cambridge University Press, 2002, §2.2].
